comparator.academicYear: Adopted 2026–2027 OER, current ordinary cohort rules; public year pages indicative 2027–2028, checked 2026-10-08
comparator.sourceNotes: Controlling adopted Dutch OER articles 7.3–7.5: 54 EC first-year required plus 6 EC free; 24 EC later common courses; selected Wiskunde line 36 EC (18 prescribed + 18 restricted, at least 6 from year three); 48 EC later genuinely free; thesis 12 EC. Total 54+6+24+36+48+12=180. First-year Reële Analyse, Statistiek and Wiskunde Practicum follow the formal current table; Introduction to Data Science is not added as another current compulsory unit. RADAr language support is required at 0 EC and not counted as an additional credited component. Writing Skills in Academia is selected from the paired writing alternatives, counted once. The first-listed Wiskunde line is selected neutrally; its restricted choices are the first two eligible year-two rows and first year-three row: Complexe Analyse, Maattheorie, Inleiding PDV, each 6 EC. Later free space remains generic. The ordinary domestic single-degree route retains Bachelor Seminar; conditional waivers for education minor, mobility or double bachelor are not assumed. Article 8.1 permits the old 48-EC line only for entrants in 2024–2025 or earlier, which is not this route. Public year pages all say indicative 2027–2028; their old 48-EC line and 36-EC free-space narrative does not override the current OER. The formal current pathway is reconstructed without asserting guaranteed future timetable availability.

routeSelection.basis: The first formal line is selected from Wiskunde, Toegepaste Wiskunde and Kansrekening en Statistiek as the neutral tie-break, without reference to UCR fit. Current 36-EC rules apply, not the older-cohort 48-EC transition. Restricted choices follow official list order while satisfying at least 6 EC from year three.

exception.reason: The external Mathematics pathway is now verified at 180 EC under the current ordinary OER. The previous UCR no-match judgment was based partly on a superseded 48-EC line and an unsupported additional 12-EC mathematics requirement. Its independent reassessment is a separate stage; no updated no-match judgment or UCR comparison is asserted here.
exception.curriculumContext: Current selected Wiskunde line: first year 54 required + 6 free; later 24 common + 36 line + 48 free + 12 thesis. Three specified line courses and three restricted choices preserve the mathematical core. The original exception and UCR evidence are preserved in the remediation register as historical assessment, not reused as an assessment of the corrected pathway.
